deferral.reason: Telling a person that someone else changed the order, and offering to reload, is screen behaviour, and the order entry screen is due for its redesign in Phase 9; doing it twice would waste the work.
deferral.targetPhase: Phase 9: user experience, visual design and accessibility
deferral.correction: PATCH /api/orders/intake/:id accepts expectedUpdatedAt and answers 409 STALE_EDIT when the order changed; the order entry screen sends the version it loaded and, on 409, says who changed it and offers to reload.
deferral.acceptance: Two people edit the same order: one is saved, the other is told and loses nothing silently.
deferral.verification: An API scenario on the intake route and a browser check with two pages open on the same order.
